done_when: Close's review of a change that adds PNG screenshots runs to a result in a new repo and in an upgraded repo, because Forge's own environment ships what Autoreview's image review needs

dismissals.because: pyproject.toml:10 Owner approved Pillow as a new moving part on 2026-10-13: Autoreview's image review needs it

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Moving part. `pyproject.toml` adds Pillow as a runtime dependency, while this fix declares `New moving parts: none`. The standard requires a new dependency to be named in the `New moving parts` line. Pillow serves the Done-when item, but its addition still breaches that approval gate.
findings.title: Standard: Fewest moving parts

why: Close cannot review a change that adds screenshots, because Autoreview's image review needs Pillow and Forge's environment lacks it
